title: Revisiting RAG Retrievers: An Information Theoretic Benchmark
authors: Wenqing Zheng; Dmitri Kalaev; Noah Fatsi; Daniel Barcklow; Owen Reinert; Igor Melnyk; Senthil Kumar; C. Bayan Bruss
why_relevant: Proposes an information-theoretic benchmark for comparing RAG retrievers, including redundancy/synergy metrics. Tangentially relevant to retrieval quality evaluation but not focused on robustness, noise, conflict, or adversarial issues.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on retriever comparison/ensembling, not on unreliable evidence, calibration, or robustness explicitly.
